description: A global IELTS practice grading platform with automated grader distribution and bi-directional review systems.
highlights: Led end-to-end architecture and deployment of a global IELTS practice grading platform utilizing Next.js and Hono.
Built a highly scalable backend architecture utilizing Cloudflare's complete serverless stack (D1, R2, KV, Durable Objects) to handle complex audio/video media uploads and global traffic routing.
Engineered a proprietary, fair-distribution algorithm to balance grader workloads and designed a bi-directional review system for quality control.
Delivered a high-performance frontend using TanStack Table to handle large grading datasets and custom Shadcn/UI for a seamless user experience.
